title: orbit-coloring-generator
description: A Sym(E)-equivariant natural bilattice homomorphism between predication fiber algebras that paints at least one Sym(E)-orbit of E x E with the constant value top regardless of source valuation; generated as the bottom-non-preserving residue of the Klein-four symmetry's bilattice-homomorphism classification.

alphaDiagonal.description: the orbit component on the diagonal orbit Delta: a lattice homomorphism L^(ExE) -> L preserving meet and join but not necessarily bounds

alphaOffDiagonal.description: the orbit component on the off-diagonal orbit Delta^c: a lattice homomorphism L^(ExE) -> L preserving meet and join but not necessarily bounds

equivariant.description: the homomorphism is Sym(E)-natural: it commutes with the symmetric-group action on E x E

failsBottomPreservation.description: at least one orbit component alpha_O equals constant-top, the exact failure of bottom-preservation that the chapter's hypothesis silently excludes

inconsistencyInjection.description: post-composing a source valuation overwrites at least one orbit with the maximally-overdetermined top, leaving that orbit paraconsistently saturated with no truth-or-falsity information
